text:
devin_procurement: Morning — vendor (NorthGate Logistics) just called: H100 tranche for EU pool delayed. ETA +72h. They also flagged missing insurance declaration and temperature-chain evidence for the palletized batch. If any units arrive DOA we need an RMA path + courier swap.

luisa_logistics: ACK. Can you drop the AWB and manifest? Need photos of packaging and the reported temp logs before we push as 'received'. Also confirm whether vendor will split into smaller AWBs for crossdock.

devin_procurement: AWB: GK1234567890. Carrier says they can split but it adds 24h. Vendor isn't providing the thermal sensor CSV yet — says forwarder has it.

carrier_bot: Tracking update (GK1234567890): origin picked up -> clearance pending -> ETD shifted +72h. Proof-of-pickup: https://track.example.com/GK1234567890 (ETA now 2025-07-03T09:00Z).

mia_ops: If it lands late we hit the EU staging queue on Mon. Depot OOS for cold-capacity at peak. Two options: 1) accept split AWB into 3 smaller pallets, crossdock into temp cooler at AMS (extra €450/pallet) or 2) reroute to FRA depot with ~48h extra transit but lower handling fees. Preference?

raj_oncall: What is the production impact? How many H100s and what fraction of scheduled capacity?

devin_procurement: 12 H100 total in this tranche — represents ~22% of EU dedicated pool for this week. If more than 8 are DOA we need emergency hot-swap from reserved US pool (costly).

luisa_logistics: Requesting forwarder thermal CSV and photos before we take delivery. I'll open an insurance evidence request now.

luisa_logistics: Opening claim ticket with vendor: "Need thermal sensor CSV + packaging photos within 12h or hold at origin". @devin_procurement tagging for contract clause reference. :exclamation:

devin_procurement: Contract clause 4.2.b covers thermal damage claims and courier responsibility. I'll escalate commercial holdback of 25% on this tranche until evidence provided.

mia_ops: Note depot capacity — if we accept split (option 1) we'll need to prebook cold bays and a crossdock crew for Sunday night. Ops can do it but incurring overtime. Estimate: €1,800 total + €200 for rapid customs brokerage.

raj_oncall: Also ensure fallback plan for inference fleet: please poke infra to reduce noncritical batch jobs + enable priority queueing. I can run a quick throttle if needed.

mia_ops: I'll schedule temporary throttles. @raj_oncall can you confirm which tenant jobs to deprioritize?

raj_oncall: Deprioritize: nightly evals, low-priority training runs, and background embedding backfills. Keep prod RL agents at full.

carrier_bot: Document upload placeholder: /carrier_docs/GK1234567890/pickup_manifest.pdf (awaiting thermal CSV).

devin_procurement: If vendor can't provide CSV we force DOA acceptance policy? Or reject at origin and demand replacement? Thoughts?

luisa_logistics: Rejecting at origin is high friction and adds 5–7 days. If vendor will split and provide sensor CSV for each AWB we can accept with conditional RMA holdback. Do that.

devin_procurement: Ok — actioning: 1) push vendor to split AWB into 3, provide per-AWB thermal CSVs and photos within 12h; 2) hold 25% payment for tranche until evidence and inspection; 3) prebook AMS coldbay for split pickup as contingency (authorize up to €2k).

mia_ops: I'll prebook coldbay and crossdock crew (provisional).

luisa_logistics: Creating RMA template for potential DOA units — will include: serial capture, depot triage checklist, immediate firmware verification, and crossship approval flow. Dropping snippet here:```\nRMA CHECKLIST:\n- Capture serial & HWID\n- Record temp-log min/max from sensor CSV\n- Photo: side, connectors, packaging\n- Power-on smoke test (30s)\n- Firmware match check (post-triage)\n- Approve crossship if DOA and replacement available\n```

raj_oncall: :thumbsup: Good. If we need urgent crossship, route through EU reserved buffer (4 units) first — use reserved PO# RG-EDGE-42.

devin_procurement: Noted. I'll send formal escalation to NorthGate and legal cc: @luisa_logistics @mia_ops.

luisa_logistics: Also loop the insurance broker — they need manifest + sensor CSV to pre-authorize any claims. I'll ping them now.

carrier_bot: Insurance broker notified. Broker ticket: INS-88921 (awaiting docs).

mia_ops: Summarizing actions: 1) vendor to split AWB + provide thermal CSVs/photos (devin) 2) prebook AMS coldbay (mia) 3) RMA template ready (luisa) 4) infra throttle plan (raj). Will reconvene when CSVs land. :eyes:

devin_procurement: Thanks all. If vendor stalls >12h we flip to reject-at-origin and pull from US buffer.
